title: fix(plugin-sharing): regime C follow-ups from objectui#12982 — close PUT /meta/sharing_rule as a third authoring door; a Setup nav entry for declared rules
body:
Filing gate **②**: measured findings from objectstack-ai/objectui#12982's dev, os-dev-report objectstack-ai/objectui#12982 (comment 6268367666) under `server_gaps`, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13050. The dev measured them on a showcase boot of `main` at `5b14b7f`.
- **Reader who acts:** the epic seat (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`), which dispatches it now.
- **Dedupe:** none. #24421 carries only 9c now.

Part of #24421 (regime C for `sharing_rule`, ruling A on #24378, 6258883445). `main` stays releasable after the merge (ruling 6266750393). No data shape changes, so the 18.0→HEAD harness has nothing to prove here, but it must stay green if it has landed.

## 1. A third authoring door (p1, a narrowing)
`/meta/types` serves `sharing_rule` with `allowRuntimeCreate: true`, and `PUT /api/v1/meta/sharing_rule/:name` saves an environment-wide registry item. The dev measured it on `probe_meta_rule`:
- the PUT answered 200;
- the item was then listed by `/meta/sharing_rule`;
- it was served by `/sharing/rules`, so it is enforced.

Under regime C a sharing rule is either a sealed declaration, switched through the activation ledger, or an organization-authored `sys_sharing_rule` row. A runtime registry item is neither: it bypasses the same-name 409 guard's model and the organization wall's ownership.

**Wanted:** the metadata door refuses to create or update a `sharing_rule` at runtime, loudly, with an ADR-0112 code, the same way positions and permission sets are sealed (`refusePackagedBaseOverride` / `allowOrgOverride: false`; measure which mechanism applies). Pin it on the HTTP door.
- If any 18.0 code path legitimately writes such items, stop and report.
- State the narrowing as FROM → TO with a one-line fix ("author an organization rule, or clone the declared one").

## 2. The Setup nav entry (the Acceptance gap of objectui#12982)
plugin-sharing's `nav_sharing_rules` points only at `sys_sharing_rule`. Add a Setup nav entry for the declared rules page, `/apps/setup/metadata/sharing_rule?scope=environment`. Make it a `type: 'url'` entry, as `nav_permission_sets` has.

## 3. Measure, do not build unless needed
- **Ledger state per item.** No single read answers "declared, and switched off" per row. The console reads `/meta/sharing_rule`, plus `/data/sys_metadata_activation` keyed by name. A meta item's own `active` shows `true` for a ledger-off rule. Recommend whether `/meta/sharing_rule` items should carry the ledger's reading. Build it only if it removes a client read without adding a new surface.
- **A switched-off declared rule.** `GET /sharing/rules/:name` answers 404 for one, so Clone falls back to the pre-filled New form. Report only.

## Acceptance
- Item 1 is refused at the door and pinned, and the ablation shows the pin is live.
- Item 2 is present in the Setup nav on a showcase boot.
- Item 3 is answered in the report.
